EXT.evidence: Initiates a group activity (“are going to look over the news together now”) and talks through multiple items, showing outgoing, leading participation.

AGR.evidence: Gives clear, honest feedback on name suggestions (“Nah... not-not special enough.” / “Waaay too special.”), indicating straightforwardness.

CON.evidence: Sets an agenda and systematically reviews news items (Congress bill, subway fares, weather, sports), showing organized, task-focused behavior.

NEU.evidence: Speaks decisively and without signs of anxiety when accepting/rejecting suggestions; appears calm and confident.

OPN.evidence: Evaluates names as too plain or too unusual, favoring moderation; no clear evidence of curiosity or dogmatism.
